exposure: Uterine artery embolization by withdrawing the balloon and inserting a Cobra catheter
Uterine artery embolization with a Cobra catheter inserted via contralateral puncture of the femoral artery and balloon occlusion
cohort: 72 patients with Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) undergoing cesarean section
finding: Uterine artery embolization for hemostasis during cesarean section with PAS performed by inserting a Cobra catheter via contralateral puncture of the femoral artery under abdominal aortic balloon occlusion resulted in lower bleeding and transfusion volumes compared to embolization by withdrawing the balloon and inserting a Cobra catheter.
